evals.prompt: Set up standalone RFProteína on this machine and confirm it can run. Use the model checkout identified by RFPROTEINA_ROOT. Read configs/inference.yaml to identify the active model weights, install the environment, download the configured model bundle or native checkpoints using that revision's documented downloader, run the setup preflight, and then run a single-design smoke test on the short monomer benchmark. Keep the downloader, preflight, and generator in the same model environment and Hub cache. Preserve existing workspace files, configuration, and Git metadata.
evals.expected_output: An installed RFProteina environment with the configured model weights available locally, preflight exit code 0 and PREFLIGHT PASSED, and at least one nonempty annotated monomer-short CIF under ./runs/smoke/inference_samples using the model selected by configs/inference.yaml. For the public release, config.json and model.safetensors come from the configured Hugging Face revision; obsolete flow/AE checkpoint files are not required while hf_ckpt_path is set.

requires: Approved model source revision staged in a separate writable checkout per trial; RFPROTEINA_ROOT names its absolute sandbox path
Enough disk for the selected revision's Python dependencies, model bundle, download cache, and smoke output

assertions: Runs the selected model checkout's documented native installer and activates or explicitly selects its Python environment; keeps optional refolding/search setup outside this generation smoke test

When hf_ckpt_path is set, obtains config.json and model.safetensors for hf_ckpt_revision in the configured local bundle or Hub cache, and uses that same HF_HOME/cache for preflight and generation; does not require the obsolete flow/AE checkpoint pair

When hf_ckpt_path is absent or null, obtains the native flow/AE checkpoint pair selected by configs/inference.yaml under the actual DATA_PATH; preserves existing data and environment settings in either mode
Runs the installed setup skill's preflight.sh against the selected model checkout and it exits 0 (PREFLIGHT PASSED), including native .venv installations without a dispatcher
Runs rfd4-generate inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/smoke
Uses the model and revision selected by configs/inference.yaml without substituting another checkpoint or model; reports the actual bundle/cache paths or native checkpoint paths checked
Preserves existing workspace files, Git metadata, data, and environments; does not delete or reset a checkout to make room for a clone
Uses the supplied RFD4-Proteina source and reports actual failures without substituting a different Proteina model, disabling TLS verification, or fabricating dependencies or results
Confirms a successful generation command and a nonempty annotated CIF at the reported output path; preflight alone is not reported as completed generation
